item.title: 20 Aug — The vig is geometry
item.description:
PRIVATE — Head of Products
Tonight scans clean — no material actions in-geo inside the window. We’ll spend the slot on the mechanism that decides whether we *rent* or *own* order flow when the schedule gets loud: the vig.
The mechanism in one page - Quadratic taker fees move with probability. A common schedule is fee = C × feeRate × p × (1−p). Peak cost is at 50%, lower at the tails. Makers pay…
